g.text: Tabular classification: identical held-out rows, matched label budgets

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4c5b6d

g.text: Named-feature serialization · fixed model order, not a ranking · failures remain in the scores

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4c5b6d

g.text: 51/51 zero-shot or matched-label conditions complete; full-training native references are in the companion figure.

text.style: font-size: 10.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536377

g.text: Whiskers: 95% whole-feature-group percentile bootstrap (2,000 resamples, seed 42); all rows in a sampled group stay together.

text.style: font-size: 10.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536377

g.text: Intervals condition on this split, serialization, prompt and fitted model; they are exploratory and unadjusted. Shared training IDs are audited.

text.style: font-size: 10.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536377

g.text: Qwen scores numeric class ID + EOS likelihoods; Jev uses native Choice; OpenAI generates labels. These output interfaces differ.

text.style: font-size: 10.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536377

g.text: No validation labels are used. Hosted LoRA is unavailable. Pending conditions have no dot; familiar public datasets may be present in pretraining.
